assertions.detail: Use the PAH-OMC-010 path K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=0 and every displayed coupling equal to one. R_max=R ranges over every positive integer. The algebraic equality is proved for arbitrary R in this declared path; finite R samples are regression checks only.

detail.N_of_f: N(f)=max(2,m_f+1). This is the least cofinal level at which the new d_n, the new column n+2 and the square-to-split frontier columns n,n+1 are outside cl(f).
detail.partition: Fix f and n>=N(f). A fine root is active only if it changes a retained ell coordinate in f or a selected closed-face holonomy. Every active root has support in cl(f); all fine roots outside cl(f), including all new-column, d_n and frontier roots, have zero lifted observable increment.
